items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: And Anne...I forget that girl's name, a White girl -- she was up and coming. I forget her name.

ctx.x: Well, I mean, what can I do? I'm in town, out of town, and all... He was the most welcome one, because I mean, his playing is beautiful. And Anne...I forget that girl's name, a White girl -- she was up and coming. I forget her name. She did the lyric, she sang it, and submitted it to the Decca office.
And that's how that came to be. From Lips' theme song to that. You have people with fantasies about the number. "What were you thinking about when you wrote 'Lover Man'?" Oh, I don't know...!
